title: Subscription SaaS dashboard
problem: a founder with a prototype but no billing or admin
approach: a typed React front end, an Express API and plan-based billing with renewal webhooks
result: launched in 6 weeks; 340 paying teams in the first quarter

title: Marketplace for local tutors
problem: a tutoring agency matching students by phone calls
approach: server-rendered search pages, booking calendar and payouts
result: 1,800 bookings in the first two months, page load under 1.2 s

title: Real-time logistics tracking
problem: dispatchers refreshing a spreadsheet to see truck locations
approach: a live map that receives positions pushed from the server every few seconds

title: Django CRM for a property agency
problem: agents tracking leads in WhatsApp groups
approach: a Django app with an admin panel, lead pipeline and scheduled email reminders
result: lead response time fell from 1 day to 2 hours

title: Shopify theme and custom checkout upsell
problem: a skincare brand with a slow, generic theme
approach: a custom theme with lazy media and a post-purchase upsell block

title: GraphQL API for a mobile fitness app
problem: a mobile team blocked by 30 bespoke REST endpoints
approach: a single typed schema with data loaders and field-level auth
result: mobile releases went from monthly to weekly

title: Firebase chat for a community app
problem: a hobby community needing chat without running servers
approach: realtime chat rooms with hosted auth and moderation rules
result: 12,000 monthly active users with zero server management

title: Supabase migration for a booking app
problem: a boutique hotel group outgrowing a no-code backend
approach: moved data to Postgres with row-level security and rebuilt the booking flow
result: monthly backend cost cut by 60%; zero downtime cut-over

title: End-to-end test suite for a fintech web app
problem: a fintech shipping regressions in its signup flow
approach: unit tests for components and browser tests for the money flows, run on every pull request
result: production incidents from the signup flow fell from 5 a month to 0 over a quarter

title: WordPress membership site
problem: a cooking blog wanting paid recipes
approach: a custom plugin for members-only content and recurring payments
result: 900 paying members in the first six months

title: Vue admin panel for inventory
problem: a hardware store chain reconciling stock by phone
approach: a reactive admin UI over a small Python API with barcode lookups
result: stock discrepancies down 75% after two months

title: Containerised deployment pipeline
problem: a startup deploying by SSH-ing into one server
approach: container images, automated tests and blue-green deploys
result: deploys went from 40 minutes and manual to 6 minutes and automatic

title: Restaurant ordering PWA
problem: a restaurant group paying 25% commission to delivery apps
approach: an installable ordering app with card checkout and a kitchen screen
result: direct orders reached 31% of volume within 3 months

title: Express API hardening and rate limiting
problem: a payments API hit by credential stuffing
approach: token rotation, per-client rate limits and audit logging
result: blocked 99.6% of malicious login attempts with no customer complaints

title: Open-source React form library (personal)
problem: repetitive form validation code across projects
approach: a small hook-based library with schema validation

title: Async report generation for a SaaS admin
problem: CSV exports timing out for large customers
approach: queued export jobs with email links when ready
result: exports of 2 million rows complete without timeouts

title: MongoDB event store for an IoT dashboard
problem: a solar installer with sensor data in CSV dumps
approach: time-bucketed documents and a live dashboard per site
result: faults spotted 2 days sooner on average

title: FastAPI backend for an ML demo
problem: a research group whose model only ran in a notebook
approach: a typed API and a simple React front end with upload progress
result: used by 300 external testers in a week
